reason: The shipping build does not assemble. The 9 added bytes move um_next (in the shipping and debug_lives builds, build/strykers.lst) from &23EF to &23F8, so um_next+8 = &2400. The ASSERT HI(um_next - 1) == HI(um_next + 8) at src/game.6502:3403 then fails: it guards LDX/LDY um_next-1,X/Y. I confirmed this by applying the candidate to a scratch copy and running build.ps1: 'src/game.6502:3411:5: error: Assertion failed' (the um_next ASSERT after the shift). relies_on says the um_next ASSERT still holds, and it does not. Everything else checks out: the opcodes are valid on the 65SC12; the branches are in range (BCC +5, BCS +12, both on page &20 with no crossing); the hot path goes from JSR 6 + BCC 3 + LDX zp 3 + LDA zp 3 + RTS 6 + BCS 2 to BCC 3 + LDX 3 + LDA 3, so 14 cycles saved a call; the code grows by 9 bytes (the JSR's 5 bytes become 14); move_mover_up_and_right and move_mover_down_and_left keep the same high byte (&20D0, &20E2). Even so, the build fails, so the candidate cannot be taken as written.
